outlook.statement: Company expects turnaround in sugar division in future but no immediate turnaround visible. Electrical division expanding geographically and increasing product mix. Demand increasing due to quality and brand value. Company increasing efforts in online platform marketing. Directors hopeful of better margins and sustained growth.

The suspension of operations is temporary and primarily due to working capital constraints and ongoing research for improving sugarcane yield in collaboration with agricultural experts. The management is of the view that operations will resume once the desired quality of cane is achieved and requisite funding is arranged.

The outlook for the Company remains positive, with the electrical goods trading business expected to continue driving growth. Company has substantially increased the operation and is looking for expansion in all geographical area through its network. Further, Company is also increasing the product mix to grab larger share of electrical goods market, which is increasing substantially due to continued demand. Also, the Company is planning to have access through various online market platform for the marketing of its product.
India's GDP growth for FY 2026-27 is projected to moderate to a range of 6.6% to 7.2%, cooling slightly from the stronger 7.4%–7.6% pace of the previous fiscal year.
The management is exploring various options to come out from the situation of sugar division suspension and hopeful that some development may take place.
The management is exploring various options to revive the Sugar Mill including arrangement of Short Term and Long Term Capital requirement for the revival of the division.

Interest Rate risk: The plan exposes the Company to the risk of fall in interest rates. A fall in interest rates will result in an increase in the ultimate cost of providing the above benefit and will thus result in an increase in the value of the liability.
Liquidity Risk: This is the risk that the company is not able to meet the short term gratuity pay-outs. This may arise due to non availability of enough cash/cash equivalents to meet the liabilities.

Salary Escalation Risk: The present value of the defined benefit plan is calculated with the assumption of salary increase rate of plan participants in future. Deviation in the rate of increase of salary in future for plan participants from the rate of increase in salary used to determine the present value of obligation will have a bearing on the plan's liability.

Demographic Risk: The Company has used certain mortality and attrition assumptions in valuation of the liability. The Company is exposed to the risk of actual experience turning out to be worse compared to the assumption.
